metadata.description: Name of the isolated proof-of-concept health model.
A region supporting Microsoft.CloudHealth, normally the resource group location.
Dedicated pay-as-you-go Log Analytics workspace for live synthetic telemetry.
Workspace-backed Application Insights component for the embedded OpenTelemetry exporters.
Provisional PoC thresholds, not service-level objectives.

variables.$fxv#0:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "__APPLICATION_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - __LOOKBACK__ .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "synthetic.probe.runs"
| where tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live" and tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "__SERVICE__"
| summarize Total = sum(Sum),
            Successful = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "success"),
            Failed = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "failure"),
            Unexecutable = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "unexecutable")
| where Total > 0
| project Value = 100.0 * Successful / Total, Total, Successful, Failed, Unexecutable
variables.$fxv#1:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "__APPLICATION_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - __LOOKBACK__ .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "__DURATION_METRIC__"
| where tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live" and tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "__SERVICE__"
// Histograms contain a sum in seconds and an observation count, not raw percentiles.
| summarize DurationSeconds = sum(Sum), Samples = sum(ItemCount)
| where Samples > 0
| project Value = 1000.0 * DurationSeconds / Samples, Samples
variables.$fxv#2:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "__APPLICATION_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - 15m .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "synthetic.probe.runs" and tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live"
| summarize ExchangeRuns = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "exchange" and TimeGenerated >= EvaluationTime - 3m),
            SharePointRuns = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) == "sharepoint" and TimeGenerated >= EvaluationTime - 11m)
| project Value = iff(ExchangeRuns > 0, 0, 1) + iff(SharePointRuns > 0, 0, 1), ExchangeRuns, SharePointRuns
variables.$fxv#3:
let EvaluationTime = now();
AppMetrics
| where _ResourceId =~ "__APPLICATION_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID__"
| where TimeGenerated between (EvaluationTime - 15m .. EvaluationTime)
| where Name == "synthetic.probe.runs" and tostring(Properties["probe.mode"]) == "live"
| where tostring(Properties["probe.service"]) in ("exchange", "sharepoint")
| summarize Value = sumif(Sum, tostring(Properties["probe.outcome"]) == "unexecutable")
